title: ForgeSight desk research and hallway notes, week of 18 August
raw_text:
FS notes — desk research + hallway stuff, wk of 18 Aug. Not written up properly, do not circulate.

- date filter. everyone asks. needs presets not a calendar picker — last 7 / last 30 / last 90 days as one click. Dana says the calendar picker is where people give up
- ??? does last 30 mean rolling or calendar month. ask Dana
- BIG ONE: dashboard must show when the data was last refreshed, visible on the dashboard itself. Northwind ops guy spent 20 mins arguing about a number that was 4 hrs old and nobody in the room could tell him how old it was. trust thing not a feature thing
- pin as home. user should be able to set one dashboard as their landing page so it opens on login. small, do it
- Halcyon legal — data residency. all Halcyon data has to stay in the EU region. this is contractual not a preference, Tom has the clause. NOT negotiable, do not let it get traded away in a scope cut
- search. once you have 40 dashboards you cant find anything. user needs to search dashboards by name. autocomplete would be nice, not required
- Wei: charts have to stay readable in black and white becuase half of these get printed for the ops meeting. so no encoding meaning in colour alone
- (tangent) Marcus wants a "what changed since last week" thing. couldnt tell if he meant the data or the dashboard config. did not write it down as a real ask, ask him
- coffee w/ Priya: she is worried abt the november date. not a req, just noting the mood
- TODO chase Tom re: the Halcyon clause wording
